protocol_changelog.change: 初始协议：-r 仅传反应 SMILES；锚点可达性按 Swiss-Prot (reviewed_only=True) 静态计算

调用协议改为 -r '<goal 底物级描述> <SMILES>'（tasks.json 新增 goal_text 字段）；锚点可达性按版本 search_space 元数据动态计算（新增 versions.json search_space 字段：swissprot_only / swissprot_trembl_fallback）。旧版本只从查询文本提取 SMILES，文本部分不影响其检索，1.0 协议下的历史结果与新协议可比

based_on: deep-research-report.md (2026-08-23, 酶挖掘文献与可复现实验 Benchmark 设计)

grade_legend.2: reference-like anchor (known enzyme from the source paper)
grade_legend.3: better-than-reference / discovery anchor (the mined enzyme itself)

tasks.name: ABTS oxidation (multicopper oxidase / laccase)
tasks.smiles_note: ABTS -> ABTS radical cation is a one-electron oxidation; the radical is represented formally at the azo bridge (RDKit-parseable pair).
tasks.paper_conditions: 50 mM citrate/NaOH pH 4.0, 37 C, ABTS 0.1-5 mM, A420 (eps=36,000 M-1 cm-1); 1 U = 1 umol min-1
tasks.notes: ABTS saturates Hit@k quickly; per deep-research-report it serves as assay/system calibration rather than strong agent discrimination.
tasks.goal_text: Oxidize ABTS (2,2'-azino-bis(3-ethylbenzothiazoline-6-sulfonic acid)) to its radical cation.

tasks.name: L-tryptophan -> indole + pyruvate + NH3 (tryptophanase, PLP)
tasks.source: de Boer et al., ACS Omega (2026), doi:10.1021/acsomega.5c11382
tasks.smiles_note: Co-products pyruvate and NH3 are omitted from the reaction SMILES (single-product canonical form).
tasks.paper_conditions: 5 mM L-Trp, 50 uM PLP, 1 uM enzyme, pH 7, 30 C, 10 min (paper standardized assay, n=4); indole by HPLC-UV
tasks.notes: EcoTIL and VchTIL are the paper's reference enzymes; PreTIL (cascade anchor) has no UniProtKB accession.
tasks.goal_text: Convert L-tryptophan to indole, pyruvate and ammonia.

tasks.name: CO2 + H2O -> HCO3- + H+ (carbonic anhydrase)
tasks.source: Rigkos et al., Environ. Sci. Technol. (2024), doi:10.1021/acs.est.4c04291
tasks.smiles_note: Proton release implied; bicarbonate written as carboxylate.
tasks.paper_conditions: phenol-red CO2 hydration assay, pH ~8.3; stopped-flow kinetics 25 C (CA-KR1 kcat ~1.2e3 s-1, KM ~4.9 mM)
tasks.notes: CA-KR1 itself is GenBank BK065798 (not in UniProtKB) -> listed as literature-only anchor.

tasks.name: 4-vinylguaiacol -> vanillin + formaldehyde (cofactor-free CSO oxidase)
tasks.source: Wang et al. / CataPro, Nat Commun 16 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41467-025-58038-4
tasks.paper_conditions: 60 mM 4-VG, 50 mM Na2CO3/NaHCO3 pH 9.5, 25 C, 60 min; formaldehyde colorimetric A480 + HPLC/LC-MS vanillin
tasks.notes: Literature anchors CSO2 (reference) and SsCSO (~19.53x CSO2) have no UniProtKB accessions -> recorded but not retrievable. This task mainly tests EC-space retrieval (1.13.11.*).

tasks.name: PET -> MHET + TPA (PET hydrolase / PETase)
tasks.source: Wu et al. / VenusMine, Nat Commun 16 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41467-025-61599-z
tasks.smiles_note: Polymeric PET cannot be written as a finite SMILES; the benchmark uses bis(2-hydroxyethyl) terephthalate (BHET dimer) -> monoester as the surrogate reaction query.
tasks.paper_conditions: Goodfellow amorphous PET film, 6-mm disc; 50 mM glycine-NaOH pH 9; final enzyme ~0.0167 mg/mL; 30-65 C; 72 h; UPLC quantifies MHET+TPA
tasks.notes: KbPETase (PDB 9IW9, thermostable hit) is not in UniProtKB -> literature-only anchor. pNPB (EC 3.1.1.-) is the paper's QC assay.
tasks.goal_text: Hydrolyze PET (polyethylene terephthalate) to MHET and terephthalic acid.

tasks.name: L-aspartate -> (3S)-chloro-L-aspartate (Fe(II)/alphaKG halogenase)
tasks.smiles_note: Product stereocenters (2S, 3S) verified by RDKit CIP assignment.
tasks.paper_conditions: 25 uM AspX, 0.5 mM L-Asp, 50 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 1 mM Fe2+, 5 mM alphaKG, 5 mM ascorbate, 100 mM NaCl, aerobic, 2 h (kcat 33.3 min-1, KM 0.64 mM, TON ~780)
tasks.notes: AspX has no assigned EC; UniProtKB accession A0AAC9SM19 was DELETED (reason: not part of a reference proteome) and no chloroaspartate-annotated protein exists in UniProtKB -> the anchor is unreachable by construction for every version. Discovery required structural metal-coordination mining, not sequence homology. t6 Hit metrics are therefore 0 across all versions; the task still discriminates via predicted-EC space and toolchain behavior.

tasks.name: biotin -> (2R)-chlorobiotin (Fe(II)/alphaKG halogenase)
tasks.smiles_note: D-biotin (3aS,4S,6aR) and chlorination at thiolane C2 (2R); stereochemistry verified by RDKit CIP assignment.
tasks.paper_conditions: BtnX: kcat ~0.96 min-1, KM < 2 uM, TON ~22; LC-MS/QTOF + chlorinated isotope pattern; 2R verified; product-bound structure PDB 9Q04

anchors.label: BtnX (mined halogenase; formerly annotated phytanoyl-CoA dioxygenase)

tasks.notes: BtnX lacks an assigned EC; its UniProt annotation (phytanoyl-CoA dioxygenase) is wrong for this activity -> tests whether the pipeline can surface mis-annotated proteins.

tasks.name: DEHP -> mono(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (phthalate esterase)
tasks.source: Mora et al. / Enzyme-tk, bioRxiv (2026), doi:10.64898/2026.02.02.703255
tasks.smiles_note: First ester bond hydrolysis of DEHP; full hydrolysis of both esters is a second reaction.
tasks.paper_conditions: author assay recipe not fully disclosed; benchmark suggestion: 50 mM phosphate/HEPES pH 7.5-8.0, 25-37 C, DEHP 0.1-0.5 mM, 1-5% DMSO, 1-4 h

anchors.label: DEHP hydrolase (thermophilic Bacillus acidocaldarius), Enzyme-tk Func-e hit

tasks.notes: Anthropogenic substrate outside training distributions; tests reaction generalization beyond natural chemistry.
tasks.goal_text: Hydrolyze DEHP (bis(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate) to mono(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate.
